imaging_report_text: 6 cycles palbociclib+exemestane: decreased metabolism in lumbar/thoracic lesions but increased density (sclerotic change). New nuclide focus right 9th rib with increased density. Primary breast tumor reduced 59%. Assessed as PD.
outcome_text: Premature switch to chemo. Re-challenge with original ET regimen at 12 mo yielded 15 months PFS with confirmed osteoblastic repair on PET-CT.

imaging_report_text: After second-line chemo: osteolytic changes right scapula coracoid (enlarged), new lesions T-spine/L1/L3/right SI joint. Multiple new nuclide foci. Assessed PD. MDT suspected pseudoprogression — recommended ET re-challenge.
outcome_text: MDT re-challenged with original ET → confirmed osteoblastic repair.

imaging_report_text: After 3 cycles palbociclib+exemestane: 6th left rib soft-tissue mass appears progressed (extended to 5th/6th intercostal spaces). Other mets regressing. PET-CT: rib SUVmax 12.4 (decreased from 17.2 baseline). Mixed response.
outcome_text: Continued palbociclib+AI; rib lesion regressed by 4 months. PFS ≥8 mo at manuscript.
